username.description: Your domain username for authenticating with the upstream proxy.

domain.description: Your Windows domain name (required for NTLM authentication).

password.description: Your domain password. For security, consider using a hash (e.g., 'PassNTLMv2') instead of plain text.

proxy_hosts.description: List of upstream proxy hosts (e.g., ['proxy.example.com:8080']). At least one required.

listen_addr.description: Local IP address to bind the Cntlm proxy listener (commonly 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0).

listen_port.description: Local port for Cntlm to accept connections (e.g., 3128).

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds for upstream proxy requests.

tunnel_hosts.description: List of hosts that should be tunneled via CONNECT (usually HTTPS hosts).

verbose.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (quiet) to 5 (debug). Higher values increase log detail.

no_proxy.description: List of hosts or patterns that should bypass the proxy entirely (e.g., internal services).

gss_fallback.description: Enable GSS-API fallback (e.g., for Kerberos fallback when NTLM fails).

cert_file.description: Path to a PEM-formatted certificate file for SSL proxying (optional, for MITM-style proxying).

tls_min_version.description: Minimum TLS version to support: '1.0', '1.1', '1.2', or '1.3'.
